synopsis: WorkSafe New Zealand’s August 2017 alert cited an ordinary-production incident in which a D10 dozer reversed into the wheel assembly of a fully loaded 777 dump truck at a tip head [f3123]. The glossary restates this regulator-described incident, connecting the D10 example to the booklet’s accident discussion [f11434, f3123]. Chapter 4 places it alongside another documented tip-head collision involving a reversing truck clipping a dozer at night; the supplied facts do not identify that second dozer as a D10 [f3357]. These facts document collision circumstances but provide no outcome or evidence of collision-mitigation system performance [f3123, f11434, f3357].

relations.note: Both describe the same regulator-cited D10 reversing collision with a loaded 777 at a tip head.
Adds another tip-head collision example alongside the D10–777 incident.
Places the glossary incident alongside another documented tip-head collision.
